status: Recommendations only; no V2 definition or production change applied.

storytelling.character_emphasis_intensity: Degree to which character experience, psychology, and development organize the work. Independent of characterization quality and compatible with strong external plot.

themes.ethical_dilemmas_centrality: Importance of consequential choices between competing moral duties, values, or harms; does not require a morally gray cast.
themes.memory_centrality: Importance of remembrance, forgetting, recollection, and the personal or social meaning of memory; not limited to amnesia.
themes.sacrifice_centrality: Importance of voluntarily giving up something significant for another person, commitment, or larger purpose.
themes.corruption_centrality: Importance of misuse of entrusted power or institutional responsibility for private or factional benefit; not generic crime or moral ambiguity.

scoring_policy: These additions are proposed vocabulary. Promote them to required generation or similarity features only after checking reliability, evidence coverage, and judged retrieval benefit.

revise_existing_attributes.proposal: Split or explicitly distinguish trust, betrayal, and deception. The current definition already includes deception; do not add an overlapping independent vote without revising it.
Add general work-level anthology/vignette structure for movies and shows; preserve series-specific episode/season continuity assessments.
Remove pervasive or sustained from severity anchors. Assess peak severity separately from frequency, duration, or fraction of exposure.
Keep its broader meaning; add explicit color treatment. Restricted colors do not imply black and white.

optional_score.visuals.black_and_white_prominence: Extent of achromatic grayscale imagery in the assessed scope. Tinted monochrome is a separate treatment.

sparse_concepts.policy: Do not require every concept on every title. Keep aliases and hierarchy in a shared registry; preserve unknown and not-assessed states outside bare score values.

event_and_role_binding.policy: Only assert co-occurrence when supported. Do not invent timestamps from a synopsis or infer same-scene facts from independent title scores.

presentation_and_format.policy: Extend the existing full-design annotations; actual capture method and apparent presentation remain distinct.

advisory_detail.policy: Specific phobias need assessed presence/exposure/absence and evidence coverage; low topic centrality is insufficient.

edition_and_offer.policy: Catalog facts with edition/offer scope; do not infer from fingerprint traits.

defer_note: These remain searchable concepts or calibration candidates. Existing existential_meaning explicitly includes freedom and mortality. Isolation, spatial restriction, and felt claustrophobia must stay distinct.
evidence_limits: Generated catalog text establishes available vocabulary, not independently verified title facts. Title audits use all-row screening and targeted semantic review. Synthetic queries do not establish audience demand. Concept seeds are proposals; not every seed was independently confirmed in the sampled title corpus.

trope_audit_addendum.status: Additional evaluation candidates and sparse concepts only; not applied to the 547-attribute draft.

scored_candidates.storytelling.foreshadowing_intensity: Importance of planted cues that anticipate later developments and reward retrospective recognition. Separate exact setup/payoff devices from surprise and writing quality.
scored_candidates.storytelling.dramatic_irony_intensity: Importance of consequential differences between audience and character knowledge. Preserve knowledge-holder and fact relations where supported.

optional_calibration_candidate.storytelling.symbolism_intensity: Importance of symbolic objects, imagery, language or recurring motifs to meaning; test reliability before adding a mandatory score.

overlap_rules: Existing fall_from_grace already includes moral decline; do not add a redundant scalar.
Existing temporal segments can hold tone/genre transitions.
Existing event/outcome relations can hold survival, victory and accountability.
Bookends aliases can overlap; existing cyclical ending already covers some cases.
Earlier query proposals remain earlier proposals, including arranged marriage, curses, wishes and precognition.
source_requirements: Preserve asserted, averted, subverted, hypothetical, quoted and referential modes.
Bind concepts to participants, events, scopes and editions when supported.
Normalize URL identities and aliases before aggregating; keep original strings and provenance.
Do not infer literal entities from trope labels such as The Dragon or The Ghost.
Verify source title identity and episode/book/adaptation scope.
Keep source labels distinct from preferred product terminology.
